risk_notes: sqlite3 CLI is referenced as a runtime dependency but no version is pinned and no installation instructions are provided.

No package manager manifest (package.json, requirements.txt, Dockerfile, etc.) is present, so the supply chain surface is limited to the host-provided sqlite3 binary and the sakila_master.db data file.

Scripts execute arbitrary SQL via shell redirection (`sqlite3 sakila_master.db < sql/*.sql`); while not a curl-pipe-shell pattern, any tampering with the .sql files would run unchecked against the database.
No integrity check (checksum/signature) for sakila_master.db or the SQL scripts is documented.
